_doc: M1.1 PROPOSAL (combat designer, docs/design/_drafts/m1.1/combat-skills.md). Perks: permanent fighter skills offered on level-up (offers generated by lifecycle, progression.md). Each perk is an extra passive block in the abilities.json passive schema plus the extensions below. Fractions are decimals; units follow the S/M suffix convention.
status: PROPOSED · TUNABLE (2026-10-26); combat balance pass 2026-10-26 (m1.1/tune-combat): four nerfs, six focus-regeneration perks reworked

offerDraw._doc: When lifecycle fills a skill slot: choose the kind first (rank-up or perk, weight 1 each while both have eligible items), then an item uniformly among eligible rank steps, or among eligible perks weighted by tier.

rules.pool: general perks plus perks of every archetype the class lists (hybrids: both)
rules.exclusive: a perk is never offered while its exclusive partner is held
rules.owned: a held perk is never offered again; perks are permanent in M1.1 (respec is FUTURE)
rules.minStats: requires.minStats compares effective stats at offer time

extensions.perPerkPassive: A fighter may carry up to perkCap perk passives in addition to its class passive; each compiles like a class passive. Auras of the same perk id from several fighters: strongest only (as class auras).

statModStats.rule: share of the freshness penalty ignored; sum clamped 0..1

effectPredicates.rule: the owner is the acting captain
the owner started this round with freshness < pct (fixed for the round)
the owner entered from the reserves (or as an emergency entrant) for this round

triggerEvents.rule: fires once per round at the commit where the owner first has HP below pct (after Deathward)
fires when the owner releases an active ability (optionally only a1 or a2)

extensions.triggerIf: Trigger gains optional `if: EffectPredicate`, evaluated when the event happens (target_* predicates read the trigger target).
extensions.auraRequires: Aura gains optional `requires: EffectPredicate`, evaluated on the aura owner every aura recalculation.

lifecycleEffects.rule: multiplies freshness drain per round played
adds freshness to the fighter at each between-round step of a match it is in (active or reserve), before the next round

lifecycleEffects.note: same semantics as the trait effect type

extensions.traitEffects: Perks may carry combat-owned trait effect types (captainRally, shakenImmune, enemyComposureAura, combat) with trait semantics.

aiPreferences._doc: Weights for the AI auto-pick among offered skills (lifecycle generates the offers). score = base x archetypeTag x styleMult x context. For hybrids average the two archetype rows.

context.perkScore: mean of tag weights of the perk

rankScore.presetUseRule: x1.2 when the fighter's preset has a rule that uses that slot

autoPickValue._doc: Value of a skill option in rating points (levels.json autoPick compares it with 5 x ratingWeight x gain for a stat option). perk: perks[].autoPickValue x tagFactor x styleMult x context; rank: rankBase x familyBonus x passiveMult x presetUseMult. tagFactor = mean of the archetype row over the perk tags. Clamp 0.5-3.0.

aiPreferences.tieBreak: higher score, then rank before perk, then content order
